title: Harvest Time Has Arrived
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he paints a vibrant picture of the harvest season unfolding at The River Church of Kansas City, where thousands have already made decisions for Christ and a wave of soul-winning fervor is sweeping the community. In this sermon, Pastor Zehner issues a call to action, urging the church family to intensify their efforts to reach the lost and fulfill their mission to touch their county and region with the gospel. Don't miss this inspiring message that will leave you challenged, encouraged, and equipped to join in the harvest!
